title: Fix the Undersized String Buffer
description: The program should copy the word 'Elephant' into a character array.
expectedBehavior: The program should store and print 'Elephant' correctly.
actualProblem: "Elephant" is 8 characters plus a null terminator, needing 9 bytes total, but name only has room for 8. strcpy writes the terminator one byte past the end of the array, corrupting adjacent memory (a classic buffer overflow).
explanation: A C string needs room for every character plus one extra byte for the terminating '\0'. A char array meant to hold an 8-character word must be sized at least 9, not 8.
